note: The player's crew (scripts/crew.gd). Roles from data/world/crew_labor.json; wages on the same scale as ship_economy.json's payroll (ASSUMED). Effects are per point of skill (1..5). skill_odds: chance of each skill 1..5 among people looking for work.

engineer.name: Engineer
engineer.does: Slows wear on every working part and services worn ones on the way. Brings failed parts back with a spares kit.

deck_tech.name: Deck tech
deck_tech.does: Goes out on the hull so you don't have to: patches scorch marks, plating free and holes with your patch kits, up to 50%.

pilot.name: Pilot
pilot.does: Autopilot trips burn less fuel and take less time. Brakes at the brake point when you leave the helm, and cuts the engines when anyone goes outside.

loadmaster.name: Loadmaster
loadmaster.does: Stows the load so knocks hurt it less, unloads faster, and does the unloading at the camp instead of hiring theirs.

steward.name: Steward
steward.does: Looks after passengers: better fares, and they remember you kindly.

engineer: Talks to the reactor. The reactor seems to listen.
Brings their own torque wrench. Won't say why.
Has opinions about coolant that you didn't ask for.
Fixed a freighter with a spoon once. Allegedly.
Sleeps better near the engines. Make of that what you will.
deck_tech: Happier outside than in. Takes the tether as a suggestion.
Has patched more hulls than you've seen.
Says vacuum is quieter than people.
Owns a lucky glove. Only the left one.
pilot: Lands like setting down a cup of tea.
Never met a brake point they liked to miss.
Hums in the cockpit. You'll get used to it.
Flew couriers on the frontier until the frontier moved.
loadmaster: Can stack a hold like a puzzle box.
Knows what everything weighs by looking at it.
Has a strap for every occasion.
Once balanced a reactor core on a pallet jack. Don't ask.
steward: Can calm a passenger with one look.
Runs a galley like a small, polite army.
Has never once been surprised by a passenger.
Keeps a drawer of spare everything.
